snippet.title: PlayStation - Tehodoki Mahjong - Nyuumon-hen (1999)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Tehodoki Mahjong: Nyuumon-hen is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Spiel and published by Naxat Soft, which was released in Japan in 1999.
